units.source_text: 正在此时，夕雾大将前来参见。

en.t: Just then, General Yugiri came to pay his respects.

units.source_text: 源氏便召他到帷屏旁边来，对他说道：“看来已绝望了。

en.t: Genji at once called him over beside the curtain screen and said to him, "It seems there is no hope now.

units.source_text: 但她多年以来怀抱出家之志，到此临终之时，不使遂其心愿，实甚可怜。

en.t: But for many years she has cherished the wish to take religious vows, and it would be truly pitiful not to let her fulfill that wish at the hour of death.

units.source_text: 祈祷的法师与诵经的僧众，此刻都已停止念诵，纷纷退去。

en.t: The priests who had been praying and the monks who had been chanting sutras had now all stopped their recitations and were withdrawing one after another.

units.source_text: 然而总还有若干人留住在此。

en.t: Even so, a number of them still remain here.

units.source_text: 现世功德今已无望，但至少希望她在冥途上获得佛力加庇之益。

en.t: Merit for this present life can no longer be hoped for, but at least I want her to receive the benefit of the Buddha's protection on the road through the next world.

units.source_text: 你去吩咐他们，快快准备为夫人落发。

en.t: Go and tell them to make haste and prepare to cut the lady's hair for taking vows.

units.source_text: 此等僧人之中，不知有谁善能授戒？”

en.t: Among these monks, I wonder who is skilled at administering the precepts?"

units.source_text: 他说时精神强自振奋，然而脸色异乎寻常，悲恸之情难堪，眼泪淌个不住。

en.t: As he spoke, he forced himself to keep his spirits up, yet his face was unnaturally pale, his grief was unbearable, and tears kept streaming down.

units.source_text: 夕雾看了，觉得此实难怪之事，自己也悲伤起来。

en.t: Seeing this, Yugiri felt that it was only natural, and he too became sorrowful.

units.source_text: 答道：“鬼怪等物，为欲迷乱人心，往往使人气绝。

en.t: He replied, "Spirits and such beings, in order to bewilder people's minds, often make someone appear to have stopped breathing.

units.source_text: 此次又是此种伎俩，亦未可知。

en.t: This time too, it may be another trick of that sort; we cannot yet know.

units.source_text: 既然如此，不管怎样，出家总是好的。

en.t: Since that is so, in any case, taking religious vows is still a good thing.

units.source_text: 即使出家一日一夜，功德也不落空。

en.t: Even if one takes vows for only a single day and night, the merit will not be in vain.

units.source_text: 不过在确已身死气绝之后，仅仅为她落发，则恐不能使死者在冥途获得光明，徒然使生者增加悲痛耳。

en.t: But if she has truly died and breathed her last, merely cutting her hair afterward may not bring light to the dead in the other world, and may only add to the grief of the living.

units.source_text: 不知父亲尊见以为如何。”

en.t: I do not know what my father's honored opinion may be."

units.source_text: 他陈述己见之后，

en.t: After he had stated his own view,

units.source_text: 还是把愿意在七七忌中诵经回向的僧众某某人等召集起来，

en.t: he nevertheless gathered together the monks who were willing to chant sutras and dedicate merit during the seven-times-seven mourning period, calling such and such persons by name,

units.source_text: 吩咐了应有事宜。

en.t: and gave them the necessary instructions.

units.source_text: 凡此种种，皆由夕雾一人料理。

en.t: All of these matters were handled by Yugiri alone.
